name: dispo
description: Sell a deal like a pro: find the buyers and build the call sheet. Taught from InvestorBase's dispo training. Signs in to the InvestorBase MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Find buyers and build the call sheet
interface.longDescription: Sell a deal the way an InvestorBase pro does. Find the buyers whose buy box fits the deal, grow the pool to target, then build the call sheet: the call order, an opener per buyer, voicemail and text drafts, and the answers to common objections. Sign in to InvestorBase to search buyers and read your deals.
